lessons_used: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected results, though winning tests frequently exceed expectations.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path hints across three tests or home notifications across two tests.
adoption layout changes showed no clear effect or degraded performance across two tests.
home wait_info changes mostly showed no clear effect across nine tests, yielding only one winning test.
Evidence remains inconsistent for sign_in copy, sign_in reorder, adoption redesign, adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, finish hint, and finish redesign due to mixed outcomes.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, including sign_in redesign, finish new_screen, and adoption new_flow.

candidates.title: Interactive pet mood preview stage
candidates.change: Add a new pet mood preview screen after picking a friend to let users test emotional reactions before finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: Support emails report custom pet issues and users take a median 89s / mean 1017s during adoption; mood previewing establishes clear expectations early.

new_pet_mood_preview.headline: Preview Your Pet's Personality
new_pet_mood_preview.body: See how your desktop companion responds to different interactions.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new preview screen within onboarding while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 21.3% with support tickets on pet issues; previous new_screen tests showed +4.7% lift.

candidates.title: Stage layout for waiting screen
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring a animated pet mascot and prominent progress status.
candidates.why: Users spend a median of 201s and mean of 2336s waiting, and 3 support emails report pet rendering failures on desktop.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Your pet is getting ready to land on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns waiting screen while maintaining its primary function of displaying pet creation progress.

candidates.score_note: Home step has moderate drop (14.5%) and long wait times; general redesigns show inconsistent outcomes.

candidates.title: Pet companion role selection flow
candidates.change: Replace path options with an interactive companion role selection flow to help users choose focus, play, or desktop ornament paths.
candidates.why: Path selection has a mean duration of 514s and 76.4% conversion; defining the pet's desktop role upfront speeds up intent clarity.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Two-column login layout with pet safety guarantee
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout showing login options alongside a pet account persistence guarantee.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complain about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery assurance critical.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe
sign_in.body: Connecting your account ensures your pet's traits and progress are saved securely across logins.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen layout without losing required sign-in functionality.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the top support complaint (8 emails) and 20% step loss; sign_in redesign lifted +3.3% in single test.

candidates.title: Account persistence clarification headline
candidates.change: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to explicitly mention retrieving existing pet profiles.
candidates.why: The single largest support issue (8 emails) involves pets missing after sign-in; explicit login copy helps users reconnect existing pets.

sign_in.headline: Log In to Restore Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in with your existing account to automatically bring back all your saved pet data.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in headline and body copy without violating any constraints.

candidates.score_note: Strong complaint alignment, but 6 prior sign_in copy tests consistently showed no positive effect (-0.3%).

candidates.title: Checklist layout for home introduction
candidates.change: Switch the home introduction layout to a structured checklist guiding users through essential desktop controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cite post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet, while finish conversion is 76.6%.

home_intro.headline: Quick Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Review key controls to manage, move, or hide your companion anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro to a checklist layout within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 23.4% and has 3 support tickets, but layout changes across steps have degraded or yielded weak results.

candidates.title: Background desktop preparation tips on waiting screen
candidates.change: Display rotating preparation status hints on the waiting screen to inform users what engine assets are being loaded.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s; progress hints maintain user engagement while loading.

waiting.hint: Configuring desktop window layer and floating pet animations...

guard.reason: Adds status hints to waiting screen while retaining pet creation job.

candidates.score_note: High wait times, but 9 prior home wait_info tests averaged only +0.6% lift with minimal impact.

candidates.title: Desktop pet interaction welcome badge
candidates.change: Display an achievement badge on the home intro screen celebrating the completion of pet setup.
candidates.why: Completion drops to 76.6% on the finish step; adding a rewarding milestone badge boosts final step completion.

guard.reason: Adds an achievement badge to home intro without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop (23.4%); finish notifications/redesigns show slight positive trend (+1.0% to +1.4%).

candidates.title: Path setup recommendation hint
candidates.change: Add a reassuring hint on the story screen noting that all pet behavior settings can be customized later.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s; clarifying that choices aren't permanent reduces decision friction.

story.hint: You can change your pet's traits and companion settings anytime after setup.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful hint to the story screen without altering core flow or jobs.

candidates.score_note: High drop (23.6%) and duration, but 3 prior tests for choose_path hints showed no clear effect (-0.5%).

candidates.title: Desktop render completion audio cue
candidates.change: Enable an audio sound cue and completion trigger on the waiting screen when the pet renders on desktop.
candidates.why: Users wait a median of 201s on the waiting screen and often tab away; an audio cue alerts them when their pet is ready.

guard.reason: Adds audio notification to waiting screen upon completion.

candidates.score_note: High wait duration on home, but home notification tests previously degraded performance (-1.8% over 2 tests).

picked: Two-column login layout with pet safety guarantee

decisions.title: Two-column login layout with pet safety guarantee

lessons_next: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected results, though winning tests frequently exceed expected gains.
Choose_path hints showed no clear positive effect or degraded performance across four tests.
Home notifications showed no clear effect across two tests.
Adoption layout changes showed no clear effect or degraded performance across two tests.
Home wait_info changes mostly showed no clear effect across nine tests, yielding only one winning test.

Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, while outcomes remain inconsistent for sign_in copy, sign_in reorder, sign_in redesign, adoption redesign, adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, finish hint, and finish redesign.
